identity.freedomStatement: Language is more than something to translate. It is a way of thinking. People learn a new language not just to swap words from one language to another, but to form thoughts, express themselves, and see more choices in front of them. Netmelon builds speaking-training technology that helps people move past language barriers so they can learn, work, and build relationships with more freedom.
identity.mission: Netmelon turns language learning into practical speaking training, so people can stop leaving a language on the page and start thinking, speaking, and connecting with the world in it.
identity.vision: We want to build a world where language never decides who gets to learn, work, belong, or take the next opportunity.
identity.companyIntroBody: Netmelon builds language-learning technology that helps people move from studying a language to actually speaking it.
identity.appIntroTitle:
Stop studying a language.
Start speaking it.
identity.appIntroBody: Naepopquiz is a language-training app that turns vocabulary, phrases, and conversations into repeatable listen-and-speak practice, helping learners build the reflex to speak in real situations.
identity.studioIntroTitle: Build speaking-practice content faster, and run it with less friction.
identity.studioIntroBody: Naepopquiz Studio gives teams a faster way to create, edit, and publish language-training content that can be used directly in the app.
identity.recruitingOneLiner: We are looking for teammates who want to build technology that helps people, not technology for its own sake.
identity.irOneLiner: IR materials are shared only after we review the request and confirm the right context.
identity.announcementEmptyBody: When company announcements are published, they will appear here.

coreValues.title: Make People Speak
coreValues.body: We measure our work by whether users actually open their mouths and speak.

coreValues.title: Think Beyond Translation
coreValues.body: We see language not as word-for-word conversion, but as a wider way to think and express yourself.

coreValues.title: Freedom Through Language
coreValues.body: We help people gain more choices, opportunities, and confidence by thinking and speaking in a new language.

coreValues.title: Technology for Training
coreValues.body: We build technology that supports repetition, practice, and real speaking, not just more explanations.

coreValues.title: Build from Truth
coreValues.body: We build on verified content, accurate data, and consistent messages.

coreValues.title: From Speaking to Action
coreValues.body: We want speaking practice to lead to real learning, work, relationships, and opportunity.
